summary: Dimension on two parallel lines now gives the distance between them, as in CATIA, instead of failing because the lines are too close to parallel for an angle. Sketches gain a point-line-distance relation {id, kind: point-line-distance, pointId, lineId, side, value} that holds a point at a positive distance, a number or an expression, from the infinite support of a line, on the stored side: left or right of the line seen from its start toward its end. Reference dimensions gain the measurement {kind: point-line-distance, pointId, lineId}, which Make driving turns into the relation with the side the point is on. Because the side is stored, the point stays on it whatever moved the point or the line before the solve: value edits, parameter and expression edits, other solves, drags, undo and redo. For two parallel lines, Dimension stores the distance from an endpoint of the second line to the first line together with a Parallel relation, and commits the distance without the Parallel, still as one edit, when the solver finds the Parallel redundant. A distance the lines already have is edited, and the Parallel is still added unless a Parallel or Collinear relation already joins them. Lines a hair off parallel, whose angle corner cannot be placed, take the distance without Parallel; lines an angle can measure still take an angle. A point and a line, or an arc or circle and a line, picked in either order or selected together, take the distance from the point or the curve's center. Two arcs or circles take Center distance, a point with an arc or circle takes the point-pair distances to its center, and an arc or circle with the origin or an axis places its center. A circle whose radius follows an expression takes all of these center distances, while its size stays with the expression. A picked arc or circle now waits for the next pick; picking it again or clicking empty space opens its size. The relation compiles to a new native signed point-to-line equation, so the native buffer protocol moves from 6 to 7 and the committed WebAssembly module is rebuilt. Split, Extend and the remaining pieces of a Trim keep the relation on the piece that keeps the line's identity and direction, which stays on the same support; Trim lists it in removedRelationIds when it deletes the line or the point. Any edit that turns a line around, swapping its endpoint identities, flips the stored side of each distance on that line it carries over unchanged, so the point keeps its physical side; the swap is read from endpoint IDs, including points joined by Coincident before or after the edit, each snapshot read on its own, never from positions, so the order of edits in a batch does not matter, and a side the same edit changes or a later edit in the batch states is kept as given. Dimension edits a distance, axis distance, coordinate or point to line distance that a coincident alias of a chosen point already carries instead of adding a duplicate the solver would reject. Reference on a saved driving length, distance, point to line distance or radial size replaces that driver with its reference measurement under the same identity in one edit, and Make driving turns it back; Reference is no longer offered while a horizontal or vertical distance is open, because it has no reference form. A redundant Parallel applied before its preview, with nothing else to submit, completes without an edit.
warning: Potentially breaking for CAD files: a document whose sketch contains a point-line-distance relation, or a reference dimension with a point-line-distance measurement, cannot be opened by release 0.0.776 or earlier, because their strict relation schema rejects the new kind. Existing documents are not migrated or rewritten; only sketches where a person or agent adds the relation carry it, and Dimension now adds it for two parallel lines, a point and a line, and an arc or circle and a line. Agents must state the relation's side; a relation without it is rejected. Potentially breaking for automation that drives the Dimension pick flow: a picked arc or circle no longer opens its size at once; pick it again or click empty space. A selected arc or circle still opens its size directly. A circle whose radius follows an expression, picked or selected, now starts a center distance instead of being skipped. Potentially breaking for people and automation driving the relations panel: Reference on a saved driving dimension now replaces it under the same identity, so it stops driving, instead of adding a separate reference beside it, and it is no longer offered while a horizontal or vertical distance is open. No breaking change for installed posts, machine packages, saved revisions or controller output.

checklist.schema: CAD schema 2 sketch graphs gain the additive relation {id, kind: point-line-distance, pointId, lineId, side: left | right, value} and the reference-dimension measurement {kind: point-line-distance, pointId, lineId}. The side is required and is seen from the line's start toward its end. The strict relation union means release 0.0.776 and earlier reject a document that contains either. No migration and no change to existing relation kinds, UPID, post, machine package, execution plan, saved revision, storage, journal or worker reply. The native buffer protocol moves from 6 to 7: version 7 appends the point-line-distance equation kind and keeps every other code, the options word and the reply format. The equation's signed target comes from the stored side. The Rust solver and committed WebAssembly module are rebuilt together with the app, and the 0.0.757 baseline comparison still asks that module through its protocol 5 adapter, which passes the new kind through for the module to reject. Post engine API remains 1 and saved-job engine remains 3.
checklist.events: No execution event, cancellation or input-version behavior change. When the solver rejects the Parallel added with a parallel-line distance only as redundant, Dimension leaves it out of the preview, or submits the distance alone once more with the same identities, signal and base version, and only one edit is accepted; when the Parallel was all it submitted, Dimension completes without an edit or history entry. The edit reducer keeps a reversed line's carried point to line distances on their physical side for every edit kind, including agent update-feature edits and a sketch draft's Finish, which releases each distance whose side the draft settled while it reversed a line before publishing its final state, so that state carries the side exactly before any solve it needs. WebMCP tools keep their arguments; set-sketch-relation accepts the new relation, which requires its side, and the reference measurement through the shared sketch schema, and the public agent guide describes both.
checklist.capabilities: No post or machine capability change. In sketches, Dimension measures two parallel or nearly parallel lines, a point or an arc or circle center from a line, two arc or circle centers, a point from an arc or circle center, and an arc or circle center from the origin or an axis, including circles whose radius follows an expression.
checklist.auditAndOutput: No generation, audit, numbering, encoding, line ending, feed or controller-file change.
checklist.installationAndStorage: No installed package, revision, browser-cache or folder storage format change. Saved documents open unchanged; a document saved with the new relation needs this release or later.
checklist.verification: cadSketchPointLineDistanceRelations.test.ts checks parsing and rejection of the relation and reference measurement, including a missing or unknown side, the signed residual on the stored side, beyond the segment and far from the origin, with the mirror position reported, invalid values and expressions, references and deletion protection, the side chosen at creation, the line-pair distance for exact, nearly parallel, a hair off parallel, tilted, crossing, far-out and collinear lines, reference measurement and Make driving with the side, and Trim, Split and Extend keeping or removing the relation. cadSketchPointLineDistancePreparation.test.ts checks with the native solver that the relation removes one freedom and holds the point on its stored side through value and expression edits and drags across the line, for forward and reversed lines on both sides and far from the origin; that the opposite stored side carries the point across; that a parameter moving the line, or the point, past the other keeps the side; that a parameter in the value does too; that undo, redo and the next edit keep it; that an existing distance with an added Parallel moves the whole line; that a reference measures without driving; that an edit swapping a line's endpoints keeps the point where it is by flipping the stored side, and swapping back restores it, while a side the same edit changes or a later edit in the batch states is kept, in either batch order and with unsolved positions, a swap through a coincident alias flips too, also when the edit removes the old end and its Coincident, an exact swap that also moves an alias from one end to the other still flips, and a draft that reverses a line publishes the sides it settled, also together with a new linear pattern; and that a Parallel between two vertical lines is reported redundant while the distance alone holds and moves both. The Rust tests check the signed value and derivatives on either side, for a reversed line and far from the origin, a zero-length line, and a solve that holds a parallel line at a signed distance. nativeBaseline.test.ts asks the 0.0.757 module through its protocol 5 adapter, which rejects the new kind, and compares every corpus, seeded and benchmark call as before. cadSiteTools.test.ts checks that cad_edit_document rejects a distance without a valid side before reaching the controller. CadSketchRelationsPanel.test.tsx checks the parallel-line distance with its Parallel and one Undo, an existing distance edited with the Parallel added or, with a Parallel already there, alone, the distance alone for lines a hair off parallel, the redundant Parallel left out after its preview and at Apply, the reference distance, the point, circle and center pairs and the endpoint error; a redundant Parallel alone completing without an edit; a line pair, point and line, point pair, horizontal distance and coordinate whose dimension sits on a coincident alias being edited rather than duplicated, with a fix shared through an alias shown fixed; and a saved point to line distance, length, distance and radius turning into its reference under the same identity and back with Make driving. CadWorkbench.test.tsx checks picks in both orders, selection, the toolbar and the context menu for parallel and slanted lines, a point and a line, a circle and a line, two circles, a point and a circle, a circle and the origin or an axis, and a circle whose radius follows an expression, which waits for its partner without opening its size, and an arc that waits for its second pick. cadSketchGraphDimensionLayout.test.ts checks the perpendicular annotation and its extension, and a zero reference whose point lies on the line, which keeps its label without arrows. Reverting each fix fails its new tests. The full Vitest suite (553 files, 6257 tests), lint, ui:check, build, solver:check (190 Rust tests; the module matches its source) and the release check pass, and e2e cad-sketch-constraints, cad-sketch-context-editing, cad-sketch-dimension-points, cad-sketch-mirror-copy, cad-sketch-reference-dimensions and cad-workflow pass in Chromium with two workers (63 tests).

publicNotes.summary: Dimension measures between parallel lines and from a point to a line.
changes: Dimension on two parallel lines gives the distance between them and keeps them parallel, instead of an angle error. Lines that another relation already keeps parallel get the distance alone, and a distance they already have is edited. Lines a hair off parallel get the distance without being made parallel.

Dimension on a point and a line gives the point's distance from the line, measured square to its full extension. The point stays on its side of the line while you edit, drag, change parameters that move it or the line, undo or redo.

An arc or circle with a line measures from its center, two arcs or circles take Center distance, a point with an arc or circle measures to its center, and an arc or circle with the origin or an axis places its center. A circle whose radius follows an expression measures from its center too.
A picked arc or circle now waits for a second pick. Pick it again or click empty space for its size.
Dimension edits a distance or coordinate that a coincident point already carries instead of adding a second one.

Reference on a saved driving length, distance or size turns it into a reference measurement in one Undo step, and Make driving turns it back. Horizontal and vertical distances have no reference form, so Reference is not offered for them.
publicNotes.compatibility: Sketches that use Point to line distance cannot be opened by release 0.0.776 or earlier. Existing documents are not changed. Installed machine packages, posts, saved revisions and controller output are unchanged.
publicNotes.action: No action needed. Open sketches that use Point to line distance with this release or later. To size an arc or circle with Dimension, pick it twice or pick it and click empty space.
